rationale: No supported, coverage-preserving optimization applies. The workflow already includes `julia-actions/cache@v3` for Julia dependency caching, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated by its 'An equivalent cache already exists' condition. The matrix runs with `fail-fast: false` because this is a breakage-detection workflow in which every package result is required to identify which external packages break; switching to `fail-fast: true` would cancel remaining matrix jobs after the first failure and lose test coverage, contravening P-LIT-FAIL-FAST's 'Every matrix outcome is required' condition and the requirement to preserve intended build and test coverage. History-based optimizations such as P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT or P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST lack the required representative successful-duration history (ci_history reports no completed runs and no measured baseline).
